# hercbls

The goal of hercbls is to automate and simplify some frequent tasks that
occur when processing data from the [U.S. Bureau of Labor
Statistics](https://www.bls.gov). That includes processing data that has
been downloaded after navigating the site [by
hand](https://www.bls.gov/data/), as well as data pulled from the
[API](https://www.bls.gov/developers/api_signature_v2.htm)

## Installation

You can install the development version of hercbls from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("higherX4Racine/hercbls")
```

# Package index

## Working with files downloaded from the BLS via a browser

The first way most people will pull data from the BLS will be a web form

- [`parse_oes_download()`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/hercbls/reference/parse_oes_download.md)
  : Read an excel spreadsheet pulled from the BLS site.

## Data

Data frames included with the package because they have helpful
definitions.

- [`EDUCATIONAL_ATTAINMENT_LEVELS`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/hercbls/reference/EDUCATIONAL_ATTAINMENT_LEVELS.md)
  : Levels of educational attainment, according to the BLS
- [`EDUCATION_ASSIGNMENTS`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/hercbls/reference/EDUCATION_ASSIGNMENTS.md)
  : Education and training assignments by detailed occupation
- [`SOC_HIERARCHY`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/hercbls/reference/SOC_HIERARCHY.md)
  : Standard Occupational Classification

## Internal

Utilities for updating package data sets or reducing repetition

### Data creation

Normally, these would be in `data-raw`, but I don’t want to include
files that are just duplicates straight from the BLS website.

- [`parse_soc_hierarchy_file()`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/hercbls/reference/parse_soc_hierarchy_file.md)
  : Read a spreadsheet of Standard Occupational Classification codes
- [`parse_education_assignments_file()`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/hercbls/reference/parse_education_assignments_file.md)
  : Read a spreadsheet of S.O.C. codes and educational levels.

### Utilities

Code that, while used frequently within the package, is probably not
going to be relevant for end users.

- [`dashed_soc_to_int()`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/hercbls/reference/dashed_soc_to_int.md)
  : Utility for converting xx-xxxx SOC codes to 6-digit integers

### Glossaries

Lookup tables for understanding different abbreviations found in BLS
data.

- [`GLOSSARY_OF_AREA_TYPES`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/hercbls/reference/GLOSSARY_OF_AREA_TYPES.md)
  : Types of geographic area
- [`GLOSSARY_OF_AREAS`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/hercbls/reference/GLOSSARY_OF_AREAS.md)
  : Specific geographic areas
- [`GLOSSARY_OF_SEASONAL_ADJUSTMENTS`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/hercbls/reference/GLOSSARY_OF_SEASONAL_ADJUSTMENTS.md)
  : Types of seasonal adjustments

### Survey Metadata

The BLS provides a set of tables on its public download site that
explain all of the cryptic abbreviations in each survey’s data.

- [`GLOSSARY_OF_SURVEYS`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/hercbls/reference/GLOSSARY_OF_SURVEYS.md)
  : The menu of surveys at the BLS API
- [`METADATA_FOR_LA`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/hercbls/reference/METADATA_FOR_LA.md)
  : Lookup tables for codes used by series "LA."
- [`METADATA_FOR_WP`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/hercbls/reference/METADATA_FOR_WP.md)
  : Lookup tables for codes used by series "WP."
